correctness.rationale: For explicitly given GP(10,2) dodecahedral edge list, 20 distinct neighbor triangles and 60 edges occur, every triangle has three free edges; removing 20 triangle-edge free pairs yields connected graph with 20 vertices, 40 edges and H1 rank 21. Independent reconstruction enumerated all 120 graph automorphisms from distance signatures (at most 20×3! local maps), 60 rotations of A5 and one central antipodal coset. Signed fixed-oriented-simplex traces of every element give rotation traces on element orders (1,2,3,5): (21,1,-3,1) and antipodal-twisted traces (1,-3,1,1). Projecting to central parity gives χ+=(11,-1,-1,1)=W6+V5 and χ-=(10,2,-2,0)=2V5, with no A5 trivial constituent. Full finite signed trace analysis proves the claimed rational A5×C2 representation, not an integral module classification.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical highly symmetric graph, and representation on homology is a meaningful refinement of the known 21-circle wedge homotopy. The exact full automorphism character specifies even/odd antipodal splitting (11/10), 6D versus 5D rational rotation constituents, and absence of invariant H1 cycles: none is determined by a Betti number. This motivates the precise finite invariant beyond reproducibility.

limitations: Only rational homology representation of this specific neighborhood complex; not integral module or equivariant homotopy classification.
Source indexing can miss another dodecahedral trace table.
